verdict: Ads are working — but leads are going missing before they're counted.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns spent $1,474.85 and recorded 14 conversions, led by your Local Services campaign at $1,171.35. At the same time, your Google Business Profile drew 116 actions — including 36 calls and 45 direction requests — a 100% jump week over week, which tells us organic demand is real and growing. The problem is that none of those conversions or calls are showing up in your CRM, meaning leads are arriving but not being captured — that is an intake tracking issue, not an advertising failure. We're actively working to close that gap now so every inbound contact is recorded going forward. Once intake is confirmed (target: August 31), you'll have a clear, accurate lead count to manage against — and heating campaigns are on schedule to go live October 1.

watch_item.issue: Leads from ads and calls are not being captured in your CRM — 14 Google Ads conversions and 36 GBP calls show zero in the system.
watch_item.fix: CRM intake tracking is being audited and repaired this period, with an intake owner confirmed by August 31 to make sure no inbound contact is lost going forward.
